verification.method: unittest offline; eval with paid API calls on demand

test.title: CheckFactsTest
test.checks: identical text clean; swapped amounts between names; a number next to the same word as in the original is not a swap (final4 q03 card was flagged against itself; the fix removed all 40 such alarms over 882 final2-4 outputs, all checked false, no other report changed); lost/added numbers; units and number words normalised; HH:00 equals hour; unit change; inverted negation; moved negation not flagged; lost name; name in another case kept; assistant utm tail is not a lost link, a lost author utm tag is; lost link; dates incl. ranges; hedge loss is a check; modality/scope/condition/attribution words that got rarer and intensifiers that got more frequent are checks; polite Вы/Ваш is not a name; a date does not span a line break; lost structural HTML tags are errors, lost emphasis tags are checks, autolinks are not tags; CLI exit codes 0/1/2

test.title: CleanPasteTest
test.checks: contentReference; source tokens and cite; assistant utm tail removed with link and punctuation kept, author utm tags kept; invisible chars; emoji ZWJ and NBSP kept; clean text untouched

test.title: RepoTest
test.checks: real tree clean; version mismatch, missing reference, CRLF and invisible chars caught

test.title: test_zip_layout
test.checks: humanizer-ru/SKILL.md at the root, ASCII names, no caches

test.title: blind comparison 4.1.1
test.checks: ranking against competitors, the one-line prompt and the previous version; fact errors by majority of three judges and check_facts; traps

test.title: EvalPatternsTest
test.checks: removed, kept and introduced counted per system; hedge «в целом» and a real range are not patterns; assistant utm counted, author utm not

test.title: EvalDshRouteTest
test.checks: other routes refused before any process starts; free route runs with --no-fallback and books nothing, list price kept; rules, system, user order in the task; failed, empty and truncated bridge answers

test.title: real run
test.checks: briefs, texts and Sol votes of final4 came through the free route (bridge log lines [M-EVAL-LIB][BLOCK_DSH] ... booked $0)

test.title: EvalBatchTest
test.checks: subagent prompt equals the API prompt except the Read sentence, same .md files only; same requests and order for every system; missing and empty outputs reported, outputs normalized; judge bundles and tasks carry no system names, answers map back to systems, collect is idempotent

test.title: real run 2026-10-21
test.checks: 9 Sonnet subagents wrote 60 outputs (collect-run: 0 missing); 3 Opus subagents answered 18 blinded bundles (collect-judge: 0 errors); summary.md has no coverage gap with probes p01/p02 excluded; places from Argon and Opus only, facts from all three judges

test.title: EvalReportTest
test.checks: one vote per judge: two passes of one judge do not outvote another judge; strict majority of 2 or 3 judges; one-judge runs keep the pass rule; equal-weight means; judge.parse repairs both Kimi K3 brace variants; rank judges give places while every judge votes on facts

test.title: reports of dev and final runs
test.checks: aggregation checked by hand against judgments.jsonl on dev1

gaps.gap: report.py, the free DSH route and the subagent batches have unit tests; the scripts that call paid APIs are checked by hand on dev runs, and the probe exclusion from coverage by the final4 summary.
check_facts.py does not see lost conditions in words ("при включённой двухфакторной аутентификации"); the skill tells the agent to reread conditions.

The comparison emulates a skill run through the API with a read_file tool; installed runs in Claude Code and DSH are checked by hand on a few texts. final4 ran the executor as Claude Code subagents in batches (README), so its numbers compare participants with each other, not with earlier runs.
